title: 'Wicked' star Marissa Bode slams Ed Sheeran after Macklemore fiasco
summary: “Wicked” actress Marissa Bode criticized Ed Sheeran after the removal of Macklemore from the singer’s “Loop” concert tour over the rapper’s pro-Palestinian remarks…

blocks.text: “Wicked” actress Marissa Bode criticized Ed Sheeran after the removal of Macklemore from the singer’s “Loop” concert tour over the rapper’s pro-Palestinian remarks onstage. Macklemore, who made pro-Palestinian comments onstage at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium earlier this month, said he was dropped from Sheeran’s tour after pressure from several venues that told the promoter they would not allow him to perform as the singer’s opening act. In response, Sheeran clarified that it was the promoter’s decision to remove Macklemore as the rapper’s contract was with them.
